item.title: Probability - Wikipedia
item.description: The probability is a number between 0 and 1; the larger the probability, the more likely the desired outcome is to occur. For example, tossing a coin twice will yield "head-head", "head-tail", "tail-head", and "tail-tail" outcomes.

item.title: Probability - Formula, Calculating, Find, Theorems, Examples
item.description: Probability is all about how likely is an event to happen. For a random experiment with sample space S, the probability of happening of an event A is calculated by the probability formula n (A)/n (S).

item.title: Probability - Math is Fun
item.description: How likely something is to happen. Many events can't be predicted with total certainty. The best we can say is how likely they are to happen, using the idea of probability. When a coin is tossed, there are two possible outcomes: Also: When a single die is thrown, there are six possible outcomes: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

item.title: Basic Probability: Formulas, Rules & Worked Examples
item.description: Learn basic probability with clear formulas, step-by-step worked examples for coins, dice & cards, an interactive calculator, and a printable cheat sheet.

item.title: Probability | Statistics and probability | Math | Khan Academy
item.description: Probability tells us how often some event will happen after many repeated trials. You've experienced probability when you've flipped a coin, rolled some dice, or looked at a weather forecast.

item.title: Probability in Maths - GeeksforGeeks
item.description: Probability is a number between 0 and 1 that measures how likely an event is to happen. A probability of 0 means the event is impossible, 1 means it is certain, and values in between show how likely it is.

item.title: Basic Concepts of Probability - GeeksforGeeks
item.description: Probability is defined as the ratio of the number of favorable outcomes to the total number of equally likely possible outcomes of a random experiment. For example, when we toss a coin, there are two possible outcomes: head or tail.

item.title: Probability theory - Wikipedia
item.description: Probability theory or probability calculus is the branch of mathematics concerned with probability. Although there are several different probability interpretations, probability theory treats the concept in a rigorous mathematical manner by expressing it through a set of axioms.

item.title: PROBABILITY Definition & Meaning - Merriam-Webster
item.description: The meaning of PROBABILITY is the chance that a given event will occur. How to use probability in a sentence.

item.title: 7.5: Basic Concepts of Probability - Mathematics LibreTexts
item.description: Sometimes it is easier to compute the probability that an event won’t happen than it is to compute the probability that it will. To apply this principle, it’s helpful to review some tricks for dealing with inequalities.
